summary_en: BML announced a share buyback program with an upper limit of 1.5 million shares (4.0% of outstanding shares) and 5 billion yen, to be executed through market purchase from November 12, 2026 through September 30, 2027. All acquired shares are scheduled for cancellation on October 29, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, BML's board of directors authorized a share buyback program under the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 1.5 million shares of its common stock, representing 4.0% of outstanding shares (37,505,465 shares as of September 30, 2026), with a total budget ceiling of 5.0 billion yen. Purchases will be executed through market transactions under a discretionary trading agreement from November 12, 2026 through September 30, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns. All shares acquired under this program will be canceled on October 29, 2027. No maximum or minimum purchase price was specified in the disclosure.
